headline: Poland Economic Credibility Score Drops Over Public Finance and Rule-of-Law Concerns
summary: Poland ranked near the bottom of an annual economic credibility survey among European states, with analysts highlighting public deficit management and judicial rule of law as primary vulnerabilities.
why: Economic credibility ratings affect sovereign credit assessments, foreign direct investment, and bond risk premiums in Central Europe.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Weaker economic credibility metric scores pressure foreign institutional investor sentiment.
